lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb4Si4C (Tb2Si2C) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Fmmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 18 atoms—8 Tb, 8 Si, and 2 C—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows C centers with 4 Tb neighbors, Si centers with 8 neighbors (2 C, 6 Tb), and Tb centers with 10 neighbors (6 Si, 4 Tb). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Si and Tb polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between C and Si polyhedra.
